[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Relation label vocabulary — a chooser that works, hidden and [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]one-off labels, and one global rename[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The Bob Mac Capture relation card is a reliable, beautiful chooser:[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Ctrl+N/P move a visible highlight through existing relation labels,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Tab accepts, and nothing collapses. Relation labels can be hidden [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from suggestions (Ctrl+D, with undo), shown again (Ctrl+H section) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and unhidden, created hidden with `~note:id||label` (with a clear [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]warning when that hides an existing label), and renamed everywhere [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]— from the card, `bob relations rename`, and Obsidian — in one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]previewed, revertable commit.[/#D7D7AF]
